method.kernel_evidence: Reuse full PHYS33 and PHYS34 raw interval certificates, exact point node labels, source constants, original generator source and independent decisions. No old main/import/test is executed.
method.algebra: Every new scientific scalar operation uses fractions.Fraction on integers, exact rationals or finite-decimal strings. No float input or limit_denominator. Closed-form endpoint operations preserve signed D and q=1-p correlation.
method.display: Exact rational endpoints authoritative. 90-digit Decimal FLOOR/CEILING division is only an outward decimal rendering; every rendered endpoint checked against exact rational.
method.slope_reference: Cref=[k(e0)-k(xref)+Dref*kprime(xref)]/Dref^2; Dref=xref-e0, same retained xref for both k and kprime. xref is not identified with exact reconstructed x0 or an exact root.
method.slope_error: E_C=M3*(d/6+Hc/3)+mu2*M4*d^2/4; Hc=max|x(delta,W)-xref| over old full tube; existing M3/M4 over whole reference and expanded interpolation paths.
method.slope_interval: [Cref_lower-E_C,Cref_upper+E_C] contains F_alpha,W and its W-average between Wp and Wu; require lower>0.
method.packet_ranges: Exact rational energy cells [B*z_i^2,B*z_(i+1)^2] reconstructed from saved z_domain and 32 equal rational cells. Select every closed cell intersecting each whole packet support; verify contiguous coverage. PHYS34 stored exact_rational_cell must match. PHYS33 original code binds reconstruction; do not infer exact cells from rounded z_interval rows.
method.probability_bounds: Vmin=what-eta-mu2*d^2>0; Vmax=what+eta; pmin=Vmin/(R^2+Vmin), pmax=Vmax/((R-d)^2+Vmax). These conservatively enclose all actual p in the tube without adaptive root refinement.
method.numerator_bounds: For endpoint [Le,Ue] and interior [Lx,Ux], Slo=min at pmin,pmax of p*Le+(1-p)*Lx; Shi=max at pmin,pmax of p*Ue+(1-p)*Ux.
method.branch_coefficients: DeltaW_s=-delta^4*c_s(delta), c_s in [Slo/(945*C_hi),Shi/(945*C_lo)] after strict positive denominator checks.
method.joint_bound: (G_p-G_u)/delta^4 in [L_upper-U_lower,U_upper-L_lower] for all 0<delta<=d. At delta=0 G_p-G_u=0 from identical profiles. Never divide by delta=0.
method.old_bounds_diagnostic: Compute the previous coarse two-branch coefficient difference from stored C_small/C_large intervals once to document what new geometric information resolved.
